title: Moderation per tenant
description:
Outcome: What must be true: each tenant's moderation queue holds only its readers' items; its editors decide; AI moderation runs under the tenant's spend ceiling (PPY-889ab5); a platform takedown (PPY-d7c279) is separate from tenant moderation; reports and bans are per tenant.

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): amplify/plugins/reader-steering (ReaderComment, ReaderReport, ModerationAction, moderation worker), the newsroom moderation panel.

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/tenant-moderation.feature):
Scenario: A tenant's moderators see only their own queue
    Given hidden comments in "alpha" and "beta"
    When an "alpha" editor opens moderation
    Then only alpha's comments are listed

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-ef2c57, PPY-889ab5. Blocks nothing in this plan yet. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: -.

Testing: Behave; adversarial suite.
Rollout: With reader features on the shared stack.
Risk and mitigation: Low once keys and rules hold.

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
